SELECT * FROM ( /* 1. 사용자가 직접 등록한 개인 일정 */ SELECT schedule_sq, user_sq, schedule_ttl, schedule_cnt, schedule_all_day_yn, schedule_type_cd, project_sq, NULL as resumeSq, NULL as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(schedule_start_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as start, DATE_FORMAT(schedule_end_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as end, DATE_FORMAT(schedule_start_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(schedule_end_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_schedule_m WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} UNION ALL /* 2-1. 개인이 스크랩한 특정 '공고' 마감일 */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, s.user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, p.project_description_txt as schedule_cnt, 'Y' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2403 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, NULL as resumeSq, NULL as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as start, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as end, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_scrap_s s JOIN tbl_project_m p ON s.project_sq = p.project_sq WHERE s.user_sq = #{userSq} AND s.project_sq IS NOT NULL UNION ALL /* 2-2. 개인이 스크랩한 '기업'의 모든 새 공고 (코드 2404) */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, s.user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, c.company_nm as schedule_cnt, /* 프론트 말머리용 기업명 */ 'Y' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2404 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, NULL as resumeSq, NULL as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as start, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as end, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_scrap_s s JOIN tbl_company_s c ON s.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN tbl_project_m p ON c.company_sq = p.company_sq WHERE s.user_sq = #{userSq} AND s.company_sq IS NOT NULL AND p.project_is_deleted_yn = 'N' UNION ALL /* 3. 개인이 지원한 프로젝트의 면접 일정 */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, #{userSq} as user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, '지원한 프로젝트의 면접 일정입니다.' as schedule_cnt, 'N' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2402 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, ah.resume_sq as resumeSq, ah.project_application_sq as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as start, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(ah.selected_interview_dtm, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as end, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_project_application_h ah JOIN tbl_project_m p ON ah.project_sq = p.project_sq JOIN tbl_resume_m r ON ah.resume_sq = r.resume_sq WHERE r.user_sq = #{userSq} AND ah.selected_interview_dtm IS NOT NULL
/* 4. 기업이 등록한 공고 모집 기간 */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, #{userSq} as user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, p.project_description_txt as schedule_cnt, 'Y' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2403 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, NULL as resumeSq, NULL as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as start, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as end, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_project_m p WHERE p.company_sq = (SELECT c.company_sq FROM tbl_company_s c WHERE c.user_sq = #{userSq}) UNION ALL /* 5. 기업이 스크랩한 '다른 기업'의 모든 새 공고 (코드 2404) */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, s.user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, c.company_nm as schedule_cnt, /* 프론트 말머리용 기업명 */ 'Y' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2404 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, NULL as resumeSq, NULL as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as start, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as end, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(p.project_recruit_end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_scrap_s s JOIN tbl_company_s c ON s.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN tbl_project_m p ON c.company_sq = p.company_sq WHERE s.user_sq = #{userSq} AND s.company_sq IS NOT NULL AND p.project_is_deleted_yn = 'N' UNION ALL /* 6. 기업이 진행하는 지원자와의 면접 일정 */ SELECT NULL as schedule_sq, #{userSq} as user_sq, p.project_ttl as schedule_ttl, '지원자와의 면접 일정입니다.' as schedule_cnt, 'N' as schedule_all_day_yn, 2402 as schedule_type_cd, p.project_sq, ah.resume_sq as resumeSq, ah.project_application_sq as applicationSq, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as start, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(ah.selected_interview_dtm, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as end, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_start_dtm, DATE_FORMAT(ah.selected_interview_dtm, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') as schedule_end_dtm FROM tbl_project_application_h ah JOIN tbl_project_m p ON ah.project_sq = p.project_sq WHERE p.company_sq = (SELECT c.company_sq FROM tbl_company_s c WHERE c.user_sq = #{userSq}) AND ah.selected_interview_dtm IS NOT NULL ) AS combined_schedule ORDER BY start ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_schedule_m ( user_sq, schedule_ttl, schedule_cnt, schedule_start_dtm, schedule_end_dtm, schedule_all_day_yn, schedule_type_cd, project_sq ) VALUES ( #{userSq}, #{scheduleTtl}, #{scheduleCnt}, #{scheduleStartDtm}, #{scheduleEndDtm}, #{scheduleAllDayYn}, #{scheduleTypeCd}, #{projectSq} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_schedule_m SET schedule_ttl = #{scheduleTtl}, schedule_cnt = #{scheduleCnt}, schedule_start_dtm = #{scheduleStartDtm}, schedule_end_dtm = #{scheduleEndDtm}, schedule_all_day_yn = #{scheduleAllDayYn}, schedule_type_cd = #{scheduleTypeCd} WHERE schedule_sq = #{scheduleSq} AND user_sq = #{userSq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_schedule_m WHERE schedule_sq = #{scheduleSq} AND user_sq = #{userSq}
